'''Paolo Piccione''' (born 24 April 1964) is an Italian [[mathematician]] working in [[differential geometry]], [[Riemannian geometry]] and [[Mathematical analysis|analysis]]. He is professor at the [[University of São Paulo]] since 1996 and president of the [[Sociedade Brasileira de Matemática|Brazilian Mathematical Society]] since 2017.

== Biography ==
Piccione was born in [[Rome]] on 24 April 1964, in a genuinely Italian family – his paternal grandfather was from Sicily; and the maternal one of central Italy – of a social class "without any particular prominence", although he enjoyed the important advances of Italian society in the postwar period, Piccione achieved an education in high-level public schools. Like his parents, three decades before him, he graduated from the same [[Sapienza University of Rome]], in Rome, where he obtained Laurea in Matematica and Master degree in 1987 supervisor by [[Alessandro Figà Talamanca]]. He received his a PhD in Mathematics degree from the [[Pennsylvania State University]] in 1994 advisor by [[Octacube (sculpture)|Adrian Ocneanu]].<ref>{{cite news | url=https://impa.br/noticias/paolo-piccione-matematica-no-sangue-e-na-tradicao/ | title=Paolo Piccione: Matemática no sangue e na tradição  | date= 7 March 2018 | newspaper=[[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada|IMPA]]}}</ref>

He is currently a full professor at the [[Institute of Mathematics and Statistics, University of São Paulo|Institute of Mathematics and Statistics]], [[University of São Paulo]], where he teaches since 1996 and completed his ''[[Doctor of Law|livre docência]] (Doctor of Law's USP)''.

== Work ==
His research has emphasis on [[differential geometry]], he works mainly on the following topics: [[calculus of variations]] and variational geometric problems, Riemannian and global Lorentzian geometry, [[Morse theory]], [[symplectic geometry]] and [[Hamiltonian system]]s. Piccione develops research that deals with topics with possible applications to physics. The main results achieved in the area of Lorentzian geometry have an interpretation within [[general relativity]].<ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.ime.usp.br/piccione | title=Paolo Piccione, Professor Titular, Departamento de Matemática  | date= 7 March 2018 | newspaper=[[University of São Paulo|USP]]}}</ref>

* [[Sociedade Brasileira de Matemática|Brazilian Mathematical Society]], President (2017-)<ref>{{cite news | url=https://impa.br/noticias/paolo-piccione-e-o-novo-diretor-da-sbm/ | title=Paolo Piccione toma posse como presidente da SBM   | date= 1 August 2017 | newspaper=[[Instituto Nacional de Matemática Pura e Aplicada|IMPA]]}}</ref>
* [[National Order of Scientific Merit]], Commander (2018)<ref>{{cite news | url=https://jornal.usp.br/universidade/pesquisadores-da-usp-recebem-maior-honraria-na-area-cientifica-do-pais/ | title=Pesquisadores da USP recebem maior honraria na área científica do País   | date= 18 October 2018 | newspaper=[[University of São Paulo]]}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
* jointly with GIAMBO, R.; [[Giulio Magli|MAGLI, G.]], "Naked Singularities Formation in the Gravitational Collapse of Barotropic Spherical Fluids.". ''[[General Relativity and Gravitation]]''. vol. 36 (2004), no. 6, pp.&nbsp;1279–1298.
* jointly with Giambo, R.; Giannoni, F.; [[Giulio Magli|MAGLI, G.]], "New solutions of Einstein equations in spherical symmetry: the Cosmic Censor to the court". ''[[Communications in Mathematical Physics]]''. vol. 235 (2003), no. 3, pp.&nbsp;545–563.
* jointly with  Exel, R.; Dokuchaev, M., "Partial Representations and Partial Group Algebras". ''[[Journal of Algebra]]''. vol. 226 (2000), no. 1, pp.&nbsp;505–532.
